name: 6-nin Shimai Harem Saimin ~Saiminjutsu de Kindan no Shimai Kantsuu
original_name: 6人姉妹ハーレム催眠～催眠術で禁断の姉妹姦通
source:

When his parents remarried he found himself surrounded by half a dozen beautiful sisters!
